executive_summary: Getinge delivered strong Q1 2025 with 6.2% organic sales growth and improved margins, driven primarily by Acute Care Therapies (12.4% organic growth). Paragonix integration progressing well with KidneyVault receiving positive feedback. CEO addresses new tariff challenges directly while maintaining positive 2025 outlook.
key_highlights: Organic sales growth of 6.2% - strongest Q1 in recent years
Adjusted EBITA margin improved to 12.1% from 11.2%
Acute Care Therapies organic growth 12.4% on ECLS and ventilator demand
Paragonix KidneyVault launched with positive user feedback
DPTE-FLEX Alpha-Port launched in Life Science
Surgical Perfusion phase-out progressing as planned

ceo_letter.author: Mattias Perjos
ceo_letter.title: President & CEO

promises.statement: Net sales for 2025 are expected to increase by 2-5% organically
Surgical Perfusion phase-out expected to make positive contribution to adjusted operating margin this year

challenges.challenge: Trade barriers and tariff escalation impacting healthcare

honesty_signals: Directly addresses tariff impact on hospitals and patients as 'hardest hit'
Openly discusses Bio-Processing challenges and response strategy
Acknowledges negative organic order intake and sales impact from Surgical Perfusion phase-out

key_quotes.quote: Unfortunately, hospitals and patients are the hardest hit in the recent escalation of trade barriers and geopolitical tension since tariffs distort competition and lead to higher costs
We are preparing for various scenarios and necessary actions. Here, price adjustments are one of many tools available
Based on global increasing care needs in the long term, and our leading position in key niches as well as a diverse supply chain, we are well positioned for what will happen next

key_narratives: Acute Care Therapies driving results with strong ECLS and ventilator demand
Paragonix integration exceeding expectations with five of six products now EU MDR approved
Surgical Perfusion phase-out progressing with expected margin benefits
Life Science challenged by Bio-Processing but responding with sales expansion and cost streamlining
mda_analysis.management_interpretation: Management views Q1 as validation of strategic positioning in key niches. Focus on preparedness for tariff scenarios while maintaining positive outlook based on long-term healthcare demand trends.

Acute Care Therapies.name: Acute Care Therapies
Acute Care Therapies.management_commentary: Strong sales of ECLS consumables and ventilators in Critical Care. KidneyVault first commercial flights. EU MDR progress for Paragonix products.

Life Science.name: Life Science
Life Science.management_commentary: Sterile Transfer continues positive trend. Bio-Processing remains challenging. Expanding sales channels in China/US while streamlining costs.

Surgical Workflows.name: Surgical Workflows
Surgical Workflows.management_commentary: Infection Control strengthening business area. Operating tables declined vs strong Q1 2024. New carbon fiber tabletop launched.

operational_highlights: KidneyVault first commercial flights with positive user feedback
Five of six Paragonix products now have EU MDR approval
CE market launch of Neural Pressure Support (NPS) for Servo-u/n ventilators
DPTE-FLEX Alpha-Port launched minimizing contamination risk
New carbon fiber tabletop for Otesus operating table system
concerns_mentioned: Bio-Processing market remains challenging particularly in Americas
Operating table sales declined vs strong prior year
Free cash flow significantly lower at SEK 160 M vs 944 M due to inventory increase
Brazil CGU investigation ongoing with SEK 482 M provision
FDA letter regarding Cardiosave and Cardiohelp products

risks.risk: Geopolitical risks including tariffs and trade barriers
CE certificate suspensions for HLS and PLS sets
FDA letter regarding Cardiosave and Cardiohelp products
Brazil CGU investigation with SEK 482 M provision

guidance.commentary: Positive outlook maintained for 2025 based on leading niche position and diverse supply chain.
